annotations.title: Browse businesses by category and place

description: Browse businesses by CATEGORY and place. Use when the caller does NOT know a specific business name, e.g. category 'italian restaurant' + city 'amsterdam' + country 'netherlands'. Full profiles (with approved Q&As) rank above basics-only placeholder entries; results carry the same stable id for get_profile and ask_business. Neighborhood and geo filtering are not supported yet.

category.description: Business category, cuisine or kind, e.g. 'italian restaurant', 'coffee roastery', 'hotel'.

city.description: City, name or slug: 'Amsterdam', 'New York' and 'new-york' all work.

country.description: Country, name, ISO code or slug: 'Netherlands', 'nl', 'USA' all work.

min_quality.description: Filter by profile quality. Default 'any' (placeholders included, ranked last).

name: discover_businesses
